summary: Describes Data Link Switching, a way to carry link-layer traffic such as SNA and NetBIOS across a TCP/IP network between switches. It is an informational document produced by an industry group rather than a standard.

eli5.summary: Some older computer systems cannot talk over the Internet directly. This describes a method of wrapping their messages so they can travel through it anyway.

questions: how does dlsw work over tcp/ip
